nodes.label: CRDT block tree document structure
nodes.rationale: Own structure stored as CRDT block tree; Markdown only for export and agents (D-01).

nodes.label: D-01 Markdown only as export/agent format
Content blocks (headings, lists, checklists, quotes, callouts, tables, code, formulas)
Instant full-text search with local index per client
nodes.rationale: Index is local on each client because the server cannot search encrypted content.

nodes.label: Export: Markdown, PDF, HTML (handwriting as images)
Agent edits review and acceptance (D-10)
nodes.rationale: Shared behaviour for iOS and web; accepting is an ordinary undoable, synced edit that only removes the mark.

nodes.label: Quiet left-margin green bar highlight
nodes.rationale: D-15: text itself is not filled or underlined; thin rounded bar on the left margin.

nodes.label: Agent edits banner (Accept all / View history)
Note created entirely by agent (D-45)
nodes.rationale: Not highlighted line-by-line; a calm banner with 'Got it' clears createdByAgent; agent-edit banner takes precedence.

nodes.label: D-10 Agent edits visible and accepted by human
D-15 Design as main principle (premium SaaS)
Unresolved [[Title]] text rendered as link
nodes.rationale: Agents write [[Title]] for notes that may not exist; editor renders it as a link and lets the app open or offer to create the note.

nodes.label: Single-tap link opening without caret (iOS)
nodes.rationale: One tap opens link without showing keyboard; long press and selection still allow editing link text.

nodes.label: Dictation and marked-text input handling (iOS)
nodes.rationale: Marked text (dictation, CJK keyboards) is inserted at caret without triggering Markdown shortcuts; unreported field changes are carried into the document so screen and document never diverge.

nodes.label: Formatting marks (bold, italic, underline, strike, code, highlight)
nodes.rationale: Without selection a mark applies to the next typed text; on selection it is active only if on the whole selection.

nodes.label: onLinkRequest / setLink link flow
nodes.rationale: Editor does not read the clipboard itself to avoid the system Paste prompt; falls back to clipboard only without onLinkRequest.

nodes.label: Preserve unknown/invalid nodes, attributes, marks
nodes.rationale: Opening a note never writes to the document; unknown content is kept and verified by a round-trip test on an agent-built note.

nodes.label: Table cell alignment (align) preservation
nodes.rationale: Cell edit changes only the edited text slice, preserving other marks (bold, agent mark, links).

nodes.label: Hide keyboard button and interactive dismiss (iOS)
nodes.rationale: iPhone system keyboard has no hide key.

nodes.label: Shared CRDT schema contract
nodes.rationale: Both editors work over the same CRDT structure, so its schema is a shared contract checked by common test vectors.

nodes.label: DatascratchEditor React component
nodes.rationale: Holds no own document state; everything lives in Y.Doc.

nodes.label: Web Markdown input shortcuts and floating format panel
Collaborator cursors via awareness (y-protocols)
nodes.rationale: Awareness changes swap only the cursor layer without recreating the editor.

nodes.label: Y.UndoManager over content and strokes
nodes.rationale: Strokes undo together with text; each stroke is a separate step.

nodes.label: Note style and cover (setNoteStyle, setNoteCover, setNoteBackdrop)
Scroll stability after open (iOS)
nodes.rationale: Notes up to 40,000 chars laid out fully on open so height doesn't change under the finger; late height changes deferred until scrolling stops, keeping top text anchored.

nodes.label: Inline $...$ formulas rendered with KaTeX
nodes.rationale: Contract only has mathBlock but agents and users write $...$ inline; rendered without changing the document; prices like $5 are excluded.

nodes.label: Robustness to foreign invalid content (y-prosemirror)
nodes.rationale: y-prosemirror deletes schema-invalid elements by default; on 2026-10-26 code blocks vanished in an agent note.

hyperedges.label: Shared document contract across iOS and web
